description:
Brief a materially different task within the same session. Unlike engram_recall, this combines goal-focused memories with optional procedural checklists; unlike engram_get_context, it ranks evidence for the task instead of returning category samples. Returns Markdown with ranked workspace/public memory and retrieval hints. Use engram_start to begin work and engram_rehydrate for lost context.

Example: {"repo":"engram","context":"Improve public-page delivery on Netlify while preserving localized SEO and onboarding."}. context states the whole goal; repo/file focus retrieval without reading local files. limit overrides depth; include_skills=false suppresses checklists. Records retrieval/session telemetry without editing knowledge. Consumes workspace daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read.

context.description: Natural-language task and relevant facts, e.g. migrate our PostgreSQL schema with zero downtime. Never include credentials or raw customer data.

depth.description: Default focused uses a small retrieval budget; deep expands it when focused results are insufficient. An explicit limit overrides the default budget.

file.description: File path/name used only as a search hint, e.g. src/auth.ts. Engram does not read or modify local files.

include_skills.description: Include relevant procedural checklists. If omitted, the server infers this from task/context keywords; false suppresses checklists.

limit.description: Maximum retrieved memories, 1–30. Omitted defaults: focused=5, deep=12; explicit values override these defaults.

repo.description: Repository slug, e.g. engram or billing-api, within the authenticated workspace. This is a memory filter, not a filesystem path or workspace selector.

session_id.description: Exact journal id from start/rehydrate/list_sessions. Disambiguates parallel work; writing requires your active session. Rehydrate may read shared or closed history.

name: engram_smarter

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Load Task Context
